whyUsDescription: We offer a comprehensive educational journey designed to foster academic rigor, leadership, and moral values.

whyUs.title: Expert Educators
whyUs.desc: Passionate teachers dedicated to mentoring, inspiring, and bringing out the best in every child.

whyUs.title: World-Class Infrastructure

whyUs.title: Safe & Nurturing Environment

processDescription: A transparent, supportive, and hassle-free path to joining our school community.

timelineSteps.title: Submit Inquiry
timelineSteps.desc: Fill out our online inquiry form with student & parent details.

timelineSteps.title: School Interaction
timelineSteps.desc: Visit our School to meet counselors and explore our learning environment.

timelineSteps.title: Assessment
timelineSteps.desc: Child participates in an age-appropriate assessment and friendly interaction.

timelineSteps.title: Verification
timelineSteps.desc: Submit required academic documents and birth record for verification.

timelineSteps.title: Final Enrollment
timelineSteps.desc: Receive confirmation, complete fee payment, and welcome to Red Rose School!

feeDescription: We provide transparent fee schedules with no hidden charges. Merit scholarships and need-based financial aid options are available for eligible candidates.
facilitiesDescription: Equipped with modern amenities to ensure safety, comfort, and interactive learning.

facilitiesList.title: School Transport
facilitiesList.desc: Safe GPS-tracked buses across major city routes.

facilitiesList.title: Student Hostel
facilitiesList.desc: Comfortable residential boarding with round-the-clock security.

faqsDescription: Got questions regarding admissions? We have answers.

faqs.question: What is the admission procedure?
faqs.answer: Fill out the online inquiry form or visit our School. After submission, our admissions team will schedule an assessment and parent interaction session.

faqs.question: Is school transportation available?
faqs.answer: Yes, we operate safe and modern bus services covering major routes across the city.

faqs.question: Are hostel / residential facilities provided?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have separate well-equipped hostel facilities for boys and girls with 24/7 care and academic supervision.

faqs.question: What are the school hours?
faqs.answer: Regular school hours are from 9:00 AM to 3:30 PM, Sunday through Friday.

contactDescription: Have questions? Reach out directly to our friendly admission counselors.
